description: PUCO (Padron Unico Consolidado Operativo) health-coverage lookup by DNI, against SISA (Ministerio de Salud de la Nacion) WS131. Falls back to a public no-credential GWT-RPC query (TURNOS_PUCO_PUBLIC, on by default) when TURNOS_SISA_USER/_PASS aren't set, and to TURNOS_FAKE_PUCO=1 for tests/demo. The fake/WS131/public chain is internal to this one connector, not a choice between connectors.
